name: Moto Guzzi Quota 1000 / 1100
engine: 949 or 1064 cc air-cooled V-twin, fuel injected, shaft drive
intro: Guzzi's tall adventure twin of the 90s. Fuel injection, shaft drive and a lot of weight up high.

K: Guzzi big twins use a car-type dry clutch and a separate gearbox and final drive. Change all three oils, not just the engine oil.

recallNote: Any recalls on bikes this old were closed long ago.
